{{Quote|You Rebel scum! Take us down! Now...|The officer|<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Imperial officer''' served at the administration center on [[Sunfall Peak]]. He boarded the [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Sunfall Peak)|governor's]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to try to stop [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives. He tangled with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Truno]] but was knocked out.<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
The officer appears in the opening short story of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
